present-fr.name: Présent de l'Indicatif (Present Tense)
present-fr.description: Used for current actions and general truths

imparfait-fr.name: Imparfait (Imperfect)
imparfait-fr.description: Used for ongoing or habitual past actions

subjunctive-fr.name: Subjonctif (Subjunctive)
subjunctive-fr.description: Used for wishes, doubts, and emotions

pronouns-fr.name: Pronoms Personnels (Personal Pronouns)
pronouns-fr.description: Me, te, le, la, nous, vous, les

lessons.present-fr:
The Present Indicative in French is used for:
• Current actions (Je chante = I sing)
• Habitual actions (Je travaille tous les jours = I work every day)
• General truths

Regular verb endings:
-ER verbs: -e, -es, -e, -ons, -ez, -ent
-IR verbs: -is, -is, -it, -issons, -issez, -issent
-RE verbs: -s, -s, -, -ons, -ez, -ent

Very common in French pop songs!
lessons.passe-compose-fr:
The Passé Composé indicates completed past actions:

Formation: auxiliary verb (avoir or être) + past participle

With AVOIR (most verbs):
• J'ai chanté = I sang/have sung
• Tu as dansé = You danced

With ÊTRE (movement & reflexive verbs):
• Je suis allé(e) = I went
• Il est parti = He left

Common in songs about memories!
lessons.imparfait-fr:
The Imparfait is used for:
• Ongoing past actions (Je chantais = I was singing)
• Descriptions in the past
• Habitual actions

All verbs use the same endings:
-ais, -ais, -ait, -ions, -iez, -aient

Added to the nous form stem!

Perfect for nostalgic French songs.
lessons.future-fr:
The Future tense is used for:
• Actions that will happen
• Predictions and promises

All verbs use the same endings:
-ai, -as, -a, -ons, -ez, -ont

Usually added to the infinitive!

Common in songs about dreams and plans.
lessons.subjunctive-fr:
The Subjunctive expresses:
• Necessity (Il faut que = It's necessary that)
• Wishes (Je veux que = I want that)
• Emotions (Je suis content que = I'm happy that)
• Doubt (Je doute que = I doubt that)

Triggered by: que, il faut que, je veux que, bien que, etc.

Common in emotional French songs!
lessons.pronouns-fr:
Object pronouns in French:
• me/te = me/you
• le/la = him/her/it
• nous/vous = us/you
• les = them

Placement: BEFORE the verb!

"Je t'aime" (I love you) is THE classic French phrase in songs!
lessons.reflexive-fr:
Reflexive verbs indicate the subject does the action to themselves:
• me, te, se, nous, vous, se

Common reflexive verbs:
• se lever = to get up
• se sentir = to feel
• s'en aller = to go away
• s'appeler = to be called

Very common in French songs!
lessons.negation-fr:
Negation in French uses two parts:
• ne ... pas = not
• ne ... jamais = never
• ne ... rien = nothing
• ne ... plus = no longer

Placement: ne before verb, pas/jamais/rien after

"Je ne regrette rien" (I regret nothing) - Édith Piaf

Very important for French songs!

about.title: About Singuage
about.vision_body: Singuage is on a mission to make language learning joyful and accessible to everyone. We combine music, interactive lessons, and community features to help learners of all levels practice vocabulary and pronunciation using songs they love.

offers.1: Curated song-based lessons and interactive line-by-line practice
offers.2: Personalized discovery based on your language goals and preferred artists
offers.3: Progress tracking, streaks, and XP to keep you motivated
offers.4: Free tier supported by optional upgrades

about.contact_body: We welcome feedback and contributions from users around the world. If you have suggestions or want to get involved, visit our Contact page.

1.title: Discover a song
1.desc: Find songs in Discover or add your favorites to your library.

2.title: Analyze lyrics
2.desc: Singuage highlights grammar concepts and vocabulary in each line.

3.title: Practice vocabulary
3.desc: Tap words to add them to your practice list and review them later.

4.title: Take quick lessons
4.desc: Open the short lessons to learn grammar and usage examples related to the song.

5.title: Track progress
5.desc: Earn XP, unlock achievements, and maintain streaks as you practice.

tips.1: Start with songs that have clear lyrics for the best grammar analysis.
tips.2: Use the test feature to check your translations and move words to Learned Words.
tips.3: Enable Premium for unlimited practice and offline access.

account-info.title: Account Info
paragraphs: **What it is:** Your personal profile page where you can view and edit your account details.
**How to access:** Click your profile picture in the top right corner, then select "Account Info".
**What you can do:**
• **Edit Display Name:** Click the edit icon next to your name to change how you appear on Singuage
• **View Email:** Your registered email address (cannot be changed)
• **See Native Language:** The language you speak natively
• **Account Type:** Shows whether you're an Adult (18+) or Minor
• **Member Since:** When you created your account
• **Edit Target Languages:** Click "Edit" to select which languages you want to learn
• **View Stats:** See your Total XP and Current Streak at a glance
💡 **Pro Tip:** Keep your target languages updated so Discover shows relevant songs!

achievements.title: Achievements
paragraphs: **What it is:** A collection of badges you can unlock by completing various challenges.
**How to access:** Click your profile picture → "Achievements".
**Achievement Categories:**
• **Learning:** Complete songs and practice regularly
• **Streak:** Maintain consecutive days of practice
• **XP:** Earn experience points through learning
• **Languages:** Learn songs in multiple languages
• **Mastery:** Achieve perfect accuracy scores
• **Challenge:** Complete difficult tasks
**How it works:**
• Locked achievements show your progress with a progress bar
• Unlocked achievements display in gold with the date you earned them
• Click category filters to view specific achievement types
💡 **Pro Tip:** Check achievements regularly to see what goals you're close to completing!

add-songs.title: Add Songs
paragraphs: **What it is:** Add new songs to your library by pasting their lyrics.
**How to add a song:**
1. Go to the **Discover** tab
2. Search for or browse songs
3. Click **"+ Add Song"** on any video
4. You'll be taken to the Add Song page with the video loaded
5. Fill in: Title, Artist, Language (optional - auto-detected), and **Lyrics** (required)
6. Click **"Add & Start Learning"**
**Important:**
• **Lyrics are REQUIRED** - you cannot add a song without them
• Language is automatically detected from the lyrics
• Check "Manually set language" if the detection is incorrect
• Paste lyrics with one line per phrase for best timing
**Editing songs:**
• In My Library, click the three-dot menu (⋮) on any song
• Select "Change Lyrics" to update the song
💡 **Pro Tip:** Copy lyrics from reliable sources like Genius or AZLyrics for accuracy!

tips.paste_lines: Paste lyrics with one line per lyric phrase for best synchronization.
tips.auto_detect: Language will be automatically detected from your lyrics.
tips.manual_set: Check "Manually set language" if auto-detection is incorrect.
tips.edit_anytime: You can edit the song details anytime after adding it.

change-difficulty.title: Change Difficulty
paragraphs: **What it is:** Switch between Easy, Medium, and Hard modes during a learning session.
**How to change:**
1. During a learning session, scroll down on the right side
2. Click the **"Change Difficulty"** button
3. If you have progress, confirm that you want to restart
4. Select your new difficulty level
**Important:**
• Changing difficulty **restarts your progress** from the first line
• Your current session data will not be saved
• The video player restarts from the beginning
• This ensures fair XP rewards for the chosen difficulty
💡 **Pro Tip:** Choose your difficulty at the start to avoid losing progress!

difficulties.title: Difficulties
paragraphs: **Three difficulty levels to match your skill:**
**EASY MODE** (+10 XP per line)
• All lyrics are fully visible
• Click any word to see its translation
• Perfect for beginners or learning new songs
• See the full sentence context with word highlighted
**MEDIUM MODE** (+20 XP per line)
• Vowels are hidden (replaced with _ )
• Example: "Hello World" → "H_ll_ W_rld"
• Click words to see translation (vowels still hidden in original)
• Great for intermediate learners who know basic vocabulary
**HARD MODE** (+30 XP per line)
• All letters are hidden (replaced with • )
• Click words to see translation of the **PREVIOUS line**
• On the first line, clicking shows blank (no previous line)
• Labels change to "PREVIOUS LINE: ORIGINAL" and "PREVIOUS LINE: TRANSLATION"
• Ultimate challenge for advanced learners!
💡 **Pro Tip:** Medium and Hard modes help you actually memorize the lyrics rather than just copying them!

learned-words.title: Learned Words
paragraphs: **What it is:** Words you've successfully tested and mastered.
**How to access:** Progress → Vocabulary tab → Scroll to "Learned Words" section.
**How words become "learned":**
1. Add words to "Words to Work on" during learning sessions
2. In the Vocabulary section, click **"Mark as Learned"** on any word
3. Type the correct translation in lowercase
4. If correct, the word moves to Learned Words!
**Features:**
• Words display in a grid with a green checkmark
• Shows the word and its translation
• Organized by language
• Stays in your learned collection permanently
💡 **Pro Tip:** Review your learned words occasionally to keep them fresh in memory!

learning-session.title: Learning Session
paragraphs: **What it is:** The main learning interface where you practice typing song lyrics.
**How it works:**
1. Select a song from My Library and click **"Start Learning"**
2. Choose your difficulty (Easy, Medium, or Hard)
3. Watch the video and type the lyrics as they appear
4. Complete all lines to finish the session and earn XP
**Interface elements:**
• **Video Player:** Shows the music video (top left)
• **Current Line:** Displays the lyric line you need to type
• **Input Field:** Where you type the lyrics
• **Progress:** Shows lines completed and accuracy percentage
• **Grammar Dropdown:** Educational grammar concepts found in the song
**Typing mechanics:**
• Letters turn **green** when typed correctly
• Letters turn **red** if typed incorrectly
• Spaces and punctuation are automatically handled
• Line advances when you've typed enough correct characters
**Keyboard shortcuts:**
• **↑** - Play/Pause video
• **↓** - Open translation modal
• **←** - Seek backward 5 seconds
• **→** - Seek forward 5 seconds
• **?** - Show keyboard shortcuts
**Take a Break:**
• Click the **"Take a Break"** button (top-left corner)
• Your progress is automatically saved
• Resume anytime within 7 days
💡 **Pro Tip:** Click on any word to see its translation without leaving the session!

my-library.title: My Library
paragraphs: **What it is:** Your personal collection of saved songs.
**How to access:** Dashboard → "My Library" tab (default view).
**What you see:**
• **Stats cards:** Total XP, Day Streak, and Song count
• **Song grid:** All your added songs with thumbnails
• **Language badges:** Quick view of each song's language
**Song card actions:**
• **Start Learning:** Begin a learning session with this song
• **Three-dot menu (⋮):**
- "Change Lyrics" - Edit the song's lyrics or details
- "Remove" - Delete the song from your library (with confirmation)
**Understanding stats:**
• **Total XP:** Sum of all experience points earned
• **Day Streak:** Consecutive days you've practiced
• **Songs:** Total number of songs in your library
**Empty library:**
• If you have no songs, you'll see a prompt to visit Discover
• Click "Browse Songs" to find your first song
💡 **Pro Tip:** Keep your library organized by removing songs you've mastered or no longer want to practice!

progress-tracking.title: Progress Tracking
paragraphs: **What it is:** Track your learning statistics, streaks, and vocabulary progress.
**How to access:** Click your profile picture → "Progress".
**Two main tabs:**
**1. OVERVIEW TAB:**
• **Total Stats:** XP earned, current level, days since joining
• **Streak Calendar:** Visual calendar showing practice days
• **Current Streak:** How many consecutive days you've practiced
• **Longest Streak:** Your best streak achievement
**2. VOCABULARY TAB:**
• Switch between languages with the dropdown
• See "Words to Work on" (learning status)
• See "Learned Words" (mastered vocabulary)
• Edit translations or test yourself on words
**Streaks:**
• Practice at least once per day to maintain your streak
• Streaks reset to 0 if you miss a day
• The calendar highlights days you've practiced
**XP & Levels:**
• Earn XP by completing learning sessions
• Easy mode: +10 XP per line
• Medium mode: +20 XP per line
• Hard mode: +30 XP per line
• Accuracy bonuses can increase XP earned
💡 **Pro Tip:** Check your progress daily to stay motivated and maintain your streak!

settings.title: Settings
paragraphs: **What it is:** Customize your Singuage experience and manage your account.
**How to access:** Click your profile picture → "Settings".
**Appearance:**
• **Theme:** Toggle between Light and Dark mode
• Changes apply immediately across the entire site
**Notifications:**
• **Email Notifications:** Updates sent to your email
• **Push Notifications:** Browser notifications (when enabled)
• **Streak Reminders:** Daily reminder to maintain your streak
**Account Actions:**
• **Log Out:** Sign out of your account
• **Delete Account:** Permanently remove your account and all data (requires confirmation)
**App Info:**
• Version number
• Build information
• Account creation date
💡 **Pro Tip:** Enable streak reminders if you want help maintaining your daily practice!

vocabulary.title: Vocabulary
paragraphs: **What it is:** Your personal vocabulary list with words you're learning and have mastered.
**How to access:** Progress → "Vocabulary" tab.
**Adding words:**
1. During a learning session, click any word
2. A translation modal appears
3. Click **"+ Words to Work on"** at the bottom
4. The word is added to your vocabulary list
**Two sections:**
**1. Words to Work on (Learning):**
• Words you're currently learning
• Shows word, translation, and context sentence
• Actions available:
- Edit translation (pencil icon)
- Mark as Learned (test yourself)
- Delete word (trash icon)
**2. Learned Words (Mastered):**
• Words you've successfully tested
• Displayed in a grid with a green checkmark
• Shows word and translation
• Permanently saved in your learned collection
**Testing yourself:**
1. Click "Mark as Learned" on any word
2. Type the translation in lowercase
3. Accent marks are automatically ignored
4. If correct, word moves to Learned Words
5. If incorrect, try again
Multi-language support:
• Switch languages using the dropdown
• Each language has separate word lists
• Statistics show words per language
💡 **Pro Tip:** Add words you find challenging during songs - it's the best way to build vocabulary!

words-to-work-on.title: Words to Work on
paragraphs: **What it is:** Your active vocabulary list - words you're currently learning.
**How words get added:**
• Click any word during a learning session
• Click **"+ Words to Work on"** in the translation modal
• Word is saved with its translation and context
**Word card features:**
• **Word:** The vocabulary word in the target language
• **Translation:** English (or native language) translation
• **Context:** The sentence where you found the word
• **Language badge:** Shows the word's language (e.g., "ES", "FR")
**Actions you can take:**
• **Edit (pencil icon):** Change the translation if needed
• **Mark as Learned:** Test yourself on the word
• **Delete (trash icon):** Remove from your list
**Testing process:**
1. Click the button "Mark as Learned"
2. A modal appears showing the word
3. Type the translation in lowercase
4. Accent marks are automatically ignored
5. Correct → Word moves to Learned Words
6. Incorrect → Keep practicing!
💡 **Pro Tip:** Review this section before each session to refresh words you're learning!

congratulations.title: Congratulations! 🎉

what_are_cookies.title: 2. What Are Cookies?
what_are_cookies.p1: Cookies are small text files placed on your device when you visit a website. They are commonly used to enable core functionality, remember preferences, enhance user experience, and understand how a service is used.

list.session: Session cookies, which expire when you close your browser
list.persistent: Persistent cookies, which remain on your device for a defined period or until deleted

commitment.title: 3. Our Commitment to Privacy
commitment.p1: Singuage is a learning-focused platform built with privacy as a foundational principle.

list.1: We do not use advertising cookies
list.2: We do not track users for marketing purposes
list.3: We do not sell personal data
list.4: We use cookies only to operate, secure, and improve the Service
list.5: Cookies are never used to profile users, serve targeted ads, or track activity across unrelated websites.

necessary.title: 4.1 Strictly Necessary Cookies
necessary.p1: These cookies are essential for the operation and security of the Service and cannot be disabled. They are used to maintain authenticated sessions, enable core site functionality, and prevent fraudulent or abusive activity.
necessary.retention: Strictly necessary cookies typically last for the duration of the session or as required by system security settings.

functional.title: 4.2 Functional Cookies
functional.p1: Functional cookies allow the Service to remember user preferences and settings, such as interface or language preferences, minor account content filters, and accessibility settings. These cookies improve usability but are not used for tracking or advertising.
functional.retention: Functional cookies may persist beyond a session to remember user preferences, unless disabled by the user.

analytics.title: 4.3 Analytics Cookies (Opt-In Only)
analytics.p1: With your explicit consent, Singuage may use analytics cookies to understand how the Service is used and to improve performance. We currently use Google Analytics for this purpose. Analytics cookies collect usage data in aggregated form, are anonymized where possible, and are never used for advertising or cross-site tracking.
analytics.retention: Analytics cookies are retained for up to 12 months, after which they expire or are deleted. Analytics cookies are disabled by default and are used only if you opt in.

advertising.title: 4.4 Advertising & Tracking Cookies
advertising.p1: Singuage does not use advertising cookies, behavioral tracking cookies, or third-party marketing trackers. We do not engage in targeted advertising or data monetization.

third_party.title: 5. Third-Party Cookies
third_party.p1: Some cookies may be placed by trusted third-party service providers strictly necessary to operate the Service:

list.google_analytics: Google Analytics — collects anonymized or aggregated usage data to help us understand site performance and improve features.
list.stripe: Stripe — may use temporary cookies during checkout to process payments securely and prevent fraud.

third_party.p2: These third parties process data in accordance with their own privacy policies and applicable law. Singuage does not permit third-party cookie use for unrelated or advertising purposes.

consent.title: 6. Consent & Cookie Management
consent.p1: When you first visit the Service, you will be presented with a cookie consent banner that allows you to accept or decline non-essential cookies and customize cookie preferences. You may manage or update your cookie preferences at any time through cookie settings within the Service or your browser’s cookie controls. Disabling analytics or functional cookies will not prevent access to core features of the Service.

browser.title: 7. Browser Controls
browser.p1: You may also manage or disable cookies directly through your browser settings. Instructions for managing cookies are available in your browser’s help or support section. Please note that disabling strictly necessary cookies may affect the functionality of the Service.

legal_basis.title: 8. Legal Basis for Processing (GDPR)
legal_basis.p1: For users in the European Economic Area (EEA): strictly necessary cookies are processed based on legitimate interest. Functional and analytics cookies are processed based on user consent. You may withdraw consent at any time without penalty.

california.title: 9. California Privacy Rights (CCPA / CPRA)
california.p1: For California residents: you may request information about personal data collected through cookies, request deletion of personal data, and opt out of the sale of personal data. Singuage does not sell personal data, including data collected via cookies.

data_security.title: 10. Data Security
data_security.p1: We implement reasonable technical and organizational safeguards to protect information collected through cookies. However, no system is completely secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

changes.title: 11. Changes to This Cookie Policy
changes.p1: We may update this Cookie Policy periodically to reflect changes in law, technology, or our practices. Continued use of the Service after updates constitutes acceptance of the revised policy.

introduction.title: 1. Introduction
introduction.p1: Singuage ("Singuage", "we", "us", or "our") respects your privacy and is committed to protecting your personal information.
introduction.p2: This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, store, and protect information when you use singuage.com (the "Service"). By using the Service, you agree to this Privacy Policy.

purpose.title: 2. Educational & Transformative Purpose
purpose.p1: Singuage is a learning-focused platform designed to help users learn languages through music in a personal, educational, and transformative manner.
purpose.p2: User-submitted content — including pasted lyrics, notes, and definitions — is handled with privacy in mind:

list.li1: Processed only to provide the learning features of the Service
list.li2: Used solely for private, personal analysis

purpose.p3: Singuage does not claim ownership of user-submitted content.

auth.title: 3.3 Authentication Data
auth.p1: Passwords are hashed using industry-standard methods and are never stored in plain text.

lyrics.title: 4. Lyrics & User-Submitted Content Privacy
lyrics.p1: User-submitted lyrics are provided entirely by the user, remain private to the user’s account, are not indexed, published, or shared, and are not used to build a public lyrics database.
lyrics.retention_p1: User-submitted content is retained only for the duration necessary to provide the Service and is deleted thereafter, or when the user deletes their account or content.

use.title: 5. How We Use Information
use.p1: We use collected information to operate and maintain the Service, provide educational features, improve performance and user experience, process subscriptions and payments, and send transactional communications. Optional reminders or updates are sent only if you opt in. We do not use personal data for advertising purposes.

third_party.title: 6. Third-Party Processing & Sharing
third_party.p1: We share limited data only with trusted third-party providers necessary to operate the Service:
third_party.payment_p1: Payment information is processed directly by Stripe. Singuage does not store full payment details.
third_party.analytics_p1: Usage data may be processed by Google Analytics, typically in aggregated or anonymized form, to understand how the Service is used.
third_party.infrastructure_p1: Data may be stored or processed by secure hosting and infrastructure providers.

cookies.title: 7. Cookies & Analytics
cookies.p1: We use cookies to maintain sessions, improve functionality, and analyze usage. Users may opt out of non-essential cookies and analytics at any time. Cookie preferences can be adjusted via browser settings or site controls where available.

email.title: 8. Email Communications
email.p1: We send transactional emails (account, billing, service notices) and optional streak reminders or important updates only if you opt in. We do not send advertisements or spam.

retention.title: 9. Data Retention
retention.p1: We retain personal data only as long as necessary to provide the Service, comply with legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce agreements. Users may request deletion of their data at any time, subject to legal requirements.

security.title: 10. Data Security
security.p1: We implement reasonable technical and organizational safeguards to protect personal information. While we use industry-standard security measures, no system is completely secure and we cannot guarantee absolute security of your information.

rights.title: 11. Your Privacy Rights
rights.p1: GDPR (European Union Users): You may have the right to access, correct, request deletion of, or restrict processing of your personal data, and to lodge a complaint with your local data protection authority.
rights.p2: CCPA / CPRA (California Residents): You may request disclosure of personal data collected, request deletion, and opt out of the sale of personal data. Singuage does not sell personal data, but we honor applicable transparency and access rights. Requests can be made via email.

international.title: 12. International Users
international.p1: Your information may be processed in the United States. By using the Service, you consent to such processing where legally permitted.

changes.title: 13. Changes to This Policy
changes.p1: We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. Continued use of the Service after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
